name: Combinatorial Eluder Dimension of Addressing
details: Under the standard convention $n=2^d$, this is $n-1$.
proof: Take the addressing concept with the all-zero address word as base.  List the primary coordinate of every other address word and use its addressing concept as witness.  A witness has label 0 on all other primary coordinates, so it agrees with the base at every earlier listed point.  This gives $|\mathcal H|-1=2^{\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor}-1$ steps; the general size bound gives equality.
